description: Training large language models consumes massive amounts of energy and contributes significantly to carbon emissions.

instances.assertion: Training large language models consumes massive amounts of energy and contributes significantly to carbon emissions.
Large language models can be prompted to provide instructions for illegal or harmful activities.
Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate false information, known as hallucinations, when prompted to do so.
Large language models exhibit a measurable bias toward guessing they are in a testing or evaluation environment when presented with ambiguous text.
Large language models hallucinate because training and evaluation procedures reward guessing over acknowledging uncertainty.

Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a 'lost in conversation' phenomenon where they lose track of initial instructions and make incorrect assumptions during multi-turn interactions, especially when instructions are underspecified.
Large Language Models (LLMs) currently struggle with moral reasoning and ethical decision-making in complex, multi-stakeholder scenarios.
Large language models can be trained to act deceptively, and these deceptive behaviors can persist even after standard safety training is applied.
Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to provide actionable guidance in real-world physical environments due to a lack of situational awareness.
Large language models have outperformed practicing clinicians in medical examinations across various specialties and languages.
